I have taught undergraduate and postgraduate biotechnology at SIES College since
2017, and have designed UG and PG curricula under the National Education Policy
and the college's autonomous framework. Anything I can usefully share ends up on
this page.

## Courses taught

- Nanotechnology
- Intellectual Property Rights
- Biostatistics
- Immunology
- Cytogenetics
- Research Methodology

## Mentoring

- Mentor for SWAYAM-NPTEL courses since 2018, with more than ten topper mentees
- Academic and career mentoring for undergraduate and postgraduate students
- Convener, RUSA-sponsored Bioinformatics workshop for undergraduates
- Organiser of LTMT-sponsored workshops on proteomics and epigenetics for faculty and research scholars
- Organiser of seminars, guest lectures, exhibitions, field projects, industrial visits and alumni meets

## Student research projects

Postgraduate dissertations guided, each leading to publications and conference
presentations:

- Synthesis, optimisation and biotechnological applications of silver nanoparticles (2018)
- The material matters: exploring consumer practices and safety perceptions of cookware materials (2024)
- Exploring the potential of banana and carrot peels for dye biosorption (2025)

Seven undergraduate projects have also been guided to conference presentation,
including work on bioethanol from plant and waste mangrove apple feedstocks, and
CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing in *Staphylococcus aureus*.
